shared_elements: carved relief signs on a flat stone face
repeated small motifs organized in rows/columns
justification: A shows a dense grid of pictorial glyph blocks, each an elaborate rounded cartouche packed with face-like and curvilinear details, arranged in regular rows and columns; B shows a pillar with sparse, shallowly incised chevron/herringbone and vertical stroke motifs plus a faint upright form, with no cartouches or figural content. The only shared feature is that both are flat stone faces bearing repeated incised marks, which is far too generic to indicate a common iconographic tradition.
